decision.candidate: ABI8-A explicit-state counter-based categorical sampling over normalized contiguous F32 probabilities
decision.reason: The source-pinned vLLM 0.24 all-seeded path launches one exponential-noise kernel per row and materializes one full rows-by-vocabulary F32 noise tensor. At 32 rows the conservative isolated result is 265.785 microseconds, 34 CUDA kernels, and 19,453,952 peak incremental bytes versus 55.176 microseconds and three kernels for the unseeded native random_sample control.

accepted: The vLLM 0.24 per-request-generator fallback exposes a material sampling-only memory and launch boundary on H20.
ABI8-A may proceed through the one-execution-pattern Rust, CUDA, bridge, PyTorch, and vLLM implementation sequence.
The measured native seeded sequence is exactly replayable, runs on a non-default current stream, and is CUDA-Graph-capturable only after every per-request generator is explicitly registered.
excluded: No Loom categorical-sampling operator exists yet, so this is not a Loom speedup claim.
The proposed Philox inverse-CDF contract intentionally does not promise PyTorch exponential-race seed-to-token identity.
The full FlashInfer-versus-native fallback gap is diagnostic context; a standalone categorical sampler cannot claim all of it.
Mixed seeded and unseeded request batches, persistent request-slot state, statistical quality, and model-level latency remain implementation and integration gates.

formal_and_confirmation_runs.provider_order: unseeded, one-seeded, and all-seeded variants reverse on alternating samples

timing_protocol.compiler_cache: Each process used isolated TorchInductor, Triton, vLLM, and FlashInfer cache roots; first-use compilation occurred during warmup, outside CUDA-event timing.

sampling_only_results.latency_interpretation: The full forward-order run was the high endpoint. The reverse-order and isolated 100-iteration runs measured 274.743 and 265.785 microseconds; the structural launch and byte evidence was identical in every run.

full_fallback_diagnostic.interpretation: These values compare the complete seeded PyTorch-native top-k/top-p fallback with the unseeded FlashInfer path. They demonstrate system context but are not an ABI8-A performance entitlement.

behavioral_gates.deterministic_replay: All row counts reproduced four sequential draws exactly in both full matrix runs when initialized with the same per-row generators.
behavioral_gates.external_current_stream: All row counts completed on a non-default current stream and profiler events used one device resource per probe.

cuda_graph_without_registration.error: Attempt to increase offset for a CUDA generator not in capture mode.

behavioral_gates.abi8_a_implication: Caller-owned device tensor state removes the need to register a Python torch.Generator per request, but graph replay and counter advancement still require direct Loom validation.

implementation_order: Rust Philox, inverse-CDF, validation, and state-advancement oracle
one handwritten CUDA execution pattern without a rows-by-vocabulary temporary
safe CUDA dispatch and checked bridge ABI 8
Stable ABI PyTorch mutation schema with current-stream, FakeTensor, compile, and CUDA Graph gates

provider-order-reversed engine evidence before any end-to-end speedup claim
